integrity: Finite exact rational coefficient certificate plus an independent exact-integer check, neither represented as external scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Only the least forbidden coefficient is classified, not the entire forbidden set. All colors with 2-adic valuation at least six and pure powers of two with positive exponent are covered; other small-valuation colors are not. A previously unindexed equivalent result cannot be excluded.
title: Sharp first three-square obstructions for highly even-colored binary partitions
